data.text/markdown:
Candidate filtering v2

Second iteration of the candidate filtering (see dataset.py for v1). Every rule is evaluated against the manually labeled repositories (run1 + run2 + consensus), so we can see how many not_ml_project it removes and how many true ML projects it loses before using it. Rules come in three stages, by cost:
  1. metadata: only uses candidates.csv (name, description, hit paths, query names).
  2. hit content: downloads the matched files (src/dataset/enrich.py hits, no API quota).
  3. repository tree + README: one API call per repo (src/dataset/enrich.py trees).
Each rule is either exclude (drops the repo) or flag (kept, annotated for inspection).

Stage 0: v1 filters, fixed

Two bugs in dataset.py:
  • owner.str.lower().isin(name_to_ignore) compares a lowercase owner with a mixed case list: GoogleCloudPlatform, Azure, IBM, NVIDIA, NVlabs, ... never match (~400 repos slip through).
  • a missing comma after "kaggle" creates the single word "kaggleпример", so neither is applied.
Also, the noise words are matched as substrings (term removes Deterministic-…, Terminal, watermarking; demo removes democracy). Here they are matched as tokens of the name (camelCase, -, _, . are split). The unsure words (notebook, colab, kaggle) are a separate rule.

The labeled repos were sampled after v1, so stage 0 should catch almost none of them; what matters is whether the fixed version loses positives (e.g. kaggle in a name is often a real competition project).

Stage 1: metadata rules

Observations from the labeled set that drive these rules:
  • not_ml_project repos are bigger, older and have more commits than ML projects (median 34 vs 15 commits, 18 MB vs 6 MB), which is why commit_count / open_issues thresholds did not help: course material and personal dumps are long-lived. Thresholds would have to go the other way, which is not defensible.
  • 30 of 35 negatives are file_storage: personal "Data-Science", "Deep-Learning", course repos. Their names are generic and their hit paths look like lessons (week02/, Task3.ipynb, lab3/).
  • Single-project class assignments (cv2526-assignment2, EC523_LoRA) are labeled ml_project, so education words alone must not exclude: they are only a flag.

Notable: sig_early_stopping also matches the Hugging Face generate(..., early_stopping=True) beam search option, which is pure inference (two of the inference_only negatives).

Stage 3: repository structure and README
